err.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The mobile / e-mail or the password is not right.
err.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Too many tries. Try again in 15 minutes.
err.CODE_EXPIRED: The code expired. Ask for a new one.
err.VALIDATION_FAILED: The password needs at least 8 characters.

pportal.login_lead: Open your file at {clinic}: your visits, records and prescriptions.
pportal.signup_lead: Enter the mobile or e-mail on your file at the clinic; a verification code will be sent.
pportal.forgot_lead: Enter your mobile or e-mail; a code to set a new password will be sent.
pportal.send_hint: The code goes to the mobile or e-mail on your file at the clinic.
pportal.code_lead: If {to} is on a file at the clinic, a 6-digit code was sent; it is valid for 10 minutes.
pportal.activate_lead: Choose a password to open your file at {clinic}.
pportal.link_expired: The link expired or was used. Ask the clinic for a new one, or use "Forgot password".
pportal.nothing_shown: The clinic has not turned on any section yet.
pportal.invite_sent: The activation link was sent to the patient.
pportal.invite_by_whatsapp: Send the activation link by WhatsApp
pportal.invite_by_sms: Send the activation link by SMS
pportal.invite_by_email: Send the activation link by e-mail
pportal.settings_lead: Patients sign in on the clinic's site with their mobile or e-mail and a password, and see only what you choose here.
pportal.set_enabled_help: A "My account" link shows on the clinic's site, with a sign-in page that has a "Staff sign-in" button.
pportal.set_self_signup_help: With a code sent to the mobile or e-mail on their file (only when one file has it).
pportal.set_sections_help: A section turned off is not shown to patients.
pportal.set_records_help: Complaint, diagnosis and plan of their visits.
pportal.set_files_help: Files and images kept on their file.
pportal.set_codes_help: Codes are sent by the clinic's messaging provider and e-mail (Settings → Messaging).
pportal.set_wa_template_help: The name of an approved WhatsApp Authentication template with one parameter, the code. Empty = no WhatsApp for codes.
pportal.first_time_hint: First time? Enter the mobile or e-mail you gave the clinic and press "Sign in" without a password.
pportal.first_lead: A verification code was sent to {to}. Enter it and choose a password; you go straight to your file.
